title: GitHub Copilot CLI Marketplace Manifest
description: Marketplace catalog read by GitHub Copilot CLI, looked up as marketplace.json, .plugin/marketplace.json, .github/plugin/marketplace.json, then .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Authored from the official CLI plugin reference; GitHub publishes no JSON Schema for this manifest.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-plugin-reference (raw markdown in github/docs). Marketplace names must be kebab-case (dots accepted for Open Plugin Spec plugins) and max 64 chars; the marketplace's own name becomes its registration key.

name.description: Kebab-case marketplace name; dots are also accepted for Open Plugin Spec plugins.
Kebab-case plugin name; dots are also accepted for Open Plugin Spec plugins.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to activate when the plugin is installed; an inline server map or a path to a JSON configuration file. Used when the plugin source does not ship its own MCP configuration.

lspServers.description: Path to LSP configuration or inline server definitions.

strict.description: When true (the default) plugins must conform to the full schema and validation rules; false enables relaxed validation for direct installs or legacy plugins.

source.description: A relative path string, or an object describing a GitHub repository or Git URL source.

sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA; pins installs against force-pushes and moved tags.
